name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.

notes: 2Q26 net revenues $20.34bn, up 39% year on year; annualised ROE 23.5% and ROTE 25.5%
Quarterly dividend raised to $5.00 from 3Q26; $4.0bn of buybacks in 2Q26
latest.source: Goldman Sachs 2Q26 earnings results (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 14 Jul 2026)
latest.tbvps_note: Estimated: reported BVPS $367.67 x (tangible common equity / common equity) from the 30 Jun 2026 10-Q via SEC XBRL: (122.742 - 13.028 - 7.342 - 1.930) / (122.742 - 13.028) $bn

thesis: Global Banking and Markets is in a strong cycle: 2Q26 net revenues rose 39% and the firm reports its highest backlog in five years.
Earnings are more cyclical than a deposit-funded bank, so through-the-cycle returns, not peak returns, should set the multiple.
Asset and Wealth Management (2Q26 revenue $4.6bn) adds steadier fee income and supports a higher multiple over time.
risks: Capital-markets activity slowing after a pulled-forward 2Q26
Trading losses or volatility in principal investments
CET1 at 12.9% leaves less buffer for buybacks than peers
sust_note: Base sustainable RoTCE 15.5%: close to the 14.6% five-year average computed from SEC filings (FY2021-FY2025, a full cycle including the weak 2022-23 deal market), plus credit for a larger Asset & Wealth Management business
